description: On the Bern side of the Susten, the Steinsee sits under the Stein Glacier, with the pass road and a low hotel along the near shore. Gadmen is only a locality of Innertkirchen, and the frame stays west of the crest, so it is not the descent to Wassen and not the Grimsel. Late-September rock and short grass carry no fresh snow. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and cool, with cloud cover a little above three-fifths, a breeze, and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
